title: Grab CEO Says AI Could Fuel Social Upheaval
key_facts: Tan spoke at Dow Jones' Risk Journal in Singapore on 6 Oct 2026.
He said rapid AI adoption could create a 'K-shaped recovery' that deepens inequality.
He cited recent social unrest in Indonesia; a Grab driver was killed during it.
Grab's AI Merchant Assistant had over one million interactions in Indonesia by June; Grab says it has lifted some small merchants' sales by up to 15%.
Grab partnered with Singapore's IMDA in May to help 10,000 SMEs build AI skills.
Tan criticised unauthorised scraping and distillation of third-party content.
quote_evidence: "AI is fun when everybody wants to talk about it, but the question is: does it help me increase my pocket, improve my earnings? That's what matters for the small guy," he said.
He described the feature as a "fractional CFO or CMO in your pocket".
why_it_matters_hint: A regional tech leader links AI adoption to inequality and social strain.
notes: WSJ page blocked (401). Same event read at Marketing-Interactive; the WSJ headline's 'social upheaval' wording is not in that text, which speaks of widening divides and unrest in Indonesia.
